aiCosts.title: AI costs

aiCosts.missingBanner: {count, plural, one {# model without a price} other {# models without a price}}. Those calls are left out of the total.
aiCosts.missingTitle: Models or units without a price
aiCosts.pricesLead: Prices come from the OpenAI bill: every 6 hours the platform reads what was charged per day and line item and creates a new version when a price moves more than 1%. Calls from that day on are repriced.
aiCosts.syncOff: Sync is off. Set OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY (an OpenAI admin key) on the API to update prices and check the bill.
aiCosts.missingSyncHint: They will be filled by the next sync once OpenAI bills the usage.
aiCosts.missingManualHint: Without sync, only a new price migration fills these items.
aiCosts.reconciliationNote: UTC days in the period already billed by OpenAI ({days}). The bill covers the whole account, or the configured project.
aiCosts.reconciliationScoped: The OpenAI bill does not split by organization, brand, or stage. Remove those filters to check it.
aiCosts.notBilledYet: OpenAI has not billed any day of this period yet.

backoffice.title: Backoffice
backoffice.presetsLead: Create looks for the whole platform. Publish them so every brand can pick them in the gallery.
backoffice.aiCostsLead: What each organization, brand, stage and post spends on AI, plus the price table.
backoffice.newKindLead: Each type has its own lab. Pick one to start. New types, such as video, will get their own screen later.
backoffice.newFormatLead: Pick the format. The lab follows the format; the ad subject (avatar, product…) is a tag for the customer gallery.

image.title: Image

carousel.title: Carousel

video.title: Video

backoffice.subjectTagHint: Chooses which /create card shows this look. The prompt and photos drive what is generated.
backoffice.refSubjectsHint: Up to 3 photos (person, product, or another subject in the prompt). All are sent on generate.
backoffice.name: Name key
backoffice.nameHint: Dash-separated i18n key, for example presets.avatar. The wording lives in the pt-BR and en files.
backoffice.promptImageHint: Write the image prompt and tap the buttons below to insert brand data. The visual style stays consistent across clients; the data personalizes each result.
backoffice.promptTextHint: Write the caption prompt and insert brand data. Generate text separately from the image.
backoffice.resultTextHint: Last caption result saved with this look.
backoffice.phonePreviewHint: How the post looks on Instagram: image on top, caption below.

backoffice.phoneEmptyCaption: Generate the caption to see it here
backoffice.includeLogoHint: Tells the AI to leave a clear corner for the real logo, which is composited later.
backoffice.includeLogoSingleHint: The brand logo sits in the chosen corner. Slide text stays out of that area.
backoffice.logoPlacementHint: Pick the corner. The resolved prompt and preview ask the AI to avoid that area.
backoffice.logoPlacementSingleHint: Pick the corner. Slide text stays out of that band.
backoffice.labBrandHint: Any brand in this environment. Only used so you can generate and preview this look in the lab (name, colors, logo). Customers always use their own brand in the product.
backoffice.labProductHint: Optional. Fill these if the prompt uses '{{product.name}}', '{{product.price}}', or '{{product.description}}'. They do not change the lab format.
backoffice.labTopicHint: On generate, the AI researches the web from the brand, picks the topic, and builds a carousel (3–5) or a single image — per the format choice. Caption follows with a soft CTA to visit or get in touch.
backoffice.labTopicAutoHint: On generate, the AI researches the web from the brand, writes the slide script and caption, and builds the carousel (3–5 slides) in one go. Single-image looks live in the Image lab.
backoffice.labTopicEmptyResult: No topic yet. Click Generate — research, script and images run together.
backoffice.labDeckScriptHint: Created with the images. At the top: format=carousel, slides, theme and layout (editorial, statement or steps). Below: brand colors, fonts and logos. Edit and save if you want; click Generate again for a new topic.
backoffice.labDeckScriptEmpty: The slide script shows up here after Generate.
backoffice.labLayoutHint: Each carousel look uses one typographic layout. Editorial is the classic; statement pushes a big headline; steps numbers each idea.
backoffice.labThemeHint: Light uses the brand background and the regular logo. Dark uses the main color and the inverted logo. Random picks when images are rendered.
backoffice.resolvedPromptHint: How the prompt looks with the selected brand. The saved text stays the same.
backoffice.resolvedPromptEmpty: Write the prompt and select a brand to see the result.
backoffice.effectivePromptHint: Full payload sent (or about to be sent) — resolved recipe, platform envelope, and final text. Updates as you edit or after Generate.
backoffice.effectivePromptEmpty: Write the recipe and select a brand to see the effective payload.
backoffice.saveBeforeGenerate: Save the look before generating with the brand and reference images.
backoffice.refLocationHint: Optional. One photo of the place/environment where the scene happens.
backoffice.refLocationOptional: Without a location, the AI invents the setting.
backoffice.refPeopleHint: Up to 3 photos. Each photo must be a different person — the AI keeps each identity.
backoffice.refPeopleHintAvatar: Up to 3 photos of the SAME person (different angles or outfits). On generate, one photo is chosen at random.
backoffice.refProductsHint: Up to 3 photos of the SAME product (different angles or details). The AI keeps that product.
backoffice.refUploadNewHint: You can pick the photos now. They upload when you create the look.
backoffice.generating: Generating image and caption… This can take about a minute. If you leave, the preview may still be ready when you return.
backoffice.enabledHint: When checked, customers see this look in the gallery when creating ads. Unchecked keeps it as a backoffice draft only.
backoffice.deleteConfirm: Delete this look? It leaves the gallery and the lab, but the row stays in the database. Ads already created from it stay intact.
backoffice.cloneConfirm: Create a draft copy of this look and open the lab?

fieldHints.presets: Fills in the tone, the text order, and the goal. You can change everything afterward.
fieldHints.name: Model name in the list. It does not appear on the published ad.
fieldHints.description: Short summary of what this model should say. It helps keep the right subject.
fieldHints.status: Active can be used to generate ads. Inactive stays hidden from the choices.
fieldHints.format: Piece type. Today it makes one ad with one image. Carousel and story come later.
fieldHints.purpose: What this ad should achieve, such as teaching, talking, or selling.
fieldHints.tones: Way of speaking. Pick a few so the text does not mix styles.
fieldHints.intensity: How much the text pushes what it wants to say.
fieldHints.guidanceDont: What the AI should avoid, such as stock phrases, tone, or forbidden subjects.
fieldHints.structure: Text order, in parts. That order guides the caption.
fieldHints.ctaType: What to ask at the end of the text.
fieldHints.ctaInstruction: Optional detail of the ask. For example: invite a question in the comments.
fieldHints.visualStyles: Look you want for the image.
fieldHints.imageUsage: Whether the ad needs an image. With none, only the text is generated.
fieldHints.composition: What shows more: the image or the text.
fieldHints.peopleMode: Says whether people may appear and whether they must follow the brand guidance.
fieldHints.imageNotes: Image details so it does not look generic.
fieldHints.includeLogo: Puts the real brand logo on the final image.
fieldHints.logoVariant: Which logo file to use: normal, for dark backgrounds, or automatic.
fieldHints.logoBackdrop: Draws a colored shape behind the logo so it shows up better.
fieldHints.logoBackdropColor: Color of the background behind the logo.
fieldHints.logoBackdropShape: Background shape, such as a circle or a rounded rectangle.
fieldHints.logoBackdropPadding: Space between the background edge and the logo.
fieldHints.logoBackdropOffsetX: Moves the logo left (−) or right (+) inside the background.
fieldHints.logoBackdropOffsetY: Moves the logo up (−) or down (+) inside the background.
fieldHints.logoBackdropOpacity: How much the background shows on the photo. 10% is almost invisible and 100% is clearly visible.
fieldHints.logoBackdropShadow: Adds a soft shadow behind the background so the logo stands out.
fieldHints.logoBackdropShadowOpacity: Shadow strength. 0 is invisible and 100 is clearly marked.
fieldHints.logoBackdropShadowBlur: How far the shadow spreads. 0 is sharp and 40 is very soft.

meta.title: Publique | Networks that keep moving
meta.description: Set up the brand once and let Publique create and publish on Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and TikTok. AI images and captions that look like the business, on autopilot.

hero.line2: You switch it on. The brand speaks.
hero.lead: Set up the brand once. Publique creates and publishes content that looks like your brand on Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and TikTok, without a full-time social media hire.
hero.trust: Autopilot with control: pause, edit, or approve whenever you want.
hero.imageAlt: Phone showing a business Instagram profile with posts created by Publique, next to the weekly publishing calendar.
hero.deviceCaption: Sample: a brand draft and the weekly calendar.

how.title: Three steps.
how.lead: From the brand website to publishing, on autopilot.

1.title: Connect the brand
1.body: Website and professional Pages. We build the profile and visual identity.

2.title: Set the cadence
2.body: Look, day, and networks. Generation follows what you configured.

3.title: Leave it on autopilot
3.body: Publique generates and publishes on the cadence you set. You follow along in the dashboard and step in only if you want.

trust.title: Autopilot on. You in command.
trust.body: AI generates the image and caption from brand facts only. It never invents prices, testimonials, or promises. Everything is visible in the dashboard: pause automation, edit a post, or require approval when it makes sense for your business.

product.title: The studio, without the studio.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Publique, operated by Mateus Carvalho Vieira Ltda - ME, handles personal data when you use the website and the product.
privacy.disclaimer: Informational text aligned with Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (LGPD). It is not legal advice. If you need guidance for your situation, consult a qualified professional.

controller.title: 1. Who controls the data
body: The controller of personal data processed in connection with Publique is the company below. Under data-protection rules, the controller decides the purposes and means of processing.

dataCollected.title: 2. Data we collect
body: Account and authentication: name, email, password (stored securely), appearance and language preferences, and session metadata.
Organization and brands: organization details, invited users, brand profiles, texts and settings you enter, and content obtained when you authorize analysis of the brand website (crawl).
Visual identity: logos, reference images, brand assets, and media files you upload or that the service generates for previews and posts.
Generated content: post drafts, captions, composed images, prompts used for generation, and technical generation metadata (model, prompt version, usage).
Social networks: tokens and account identifiers for connected accounts (for example LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook), stored encrypted, plus records of publishes you initiate.
Technical data: access and error logs, IP address, user-agent, and signals needed for security, diagnostics, and operating the service.

purposes.title: 3. Purposes
body: Provide the service: create accounts, manage organizations and brands, generate and store drafts, serve media, and publish to networks you connect.
Run integrations: authenticate with social providers via OAuth and send content when you request a publish.
Improve the product: understand failures, performance, and aggregated usage, without turning that into invasive profiling outside the service.
Security and compliance: prevent abuse, investigate incidents, and meet legal obligations when applicable.

legalBases.title: 4. Legal bases (LGPD)
body: Performance of a contract or pre-contractual steps: when processing is needed to provide Publique to you or your organization.
Legitimate interest: where appropriate for security, fraud prevention, operational improvement, and support, always weighing impact on data-subject rights.
Consent: when required by law or when a specific feature depends on explicit consent (for example non-essential cookies, if adopted later).
Compliance with a legal or regulatory obligation: when the law requires retention or disclosure of information.

sharing.title: 5. Sharing and subprocessors
body: We do not sell personal data. We share data only as needed to operate Publique, with providers under contract or terms of service, or when you authorize it (for example by connecting a social network).
OpenAI: text and image processing for content generation according to the features you use.
Meta (Instagram / Facebook) and LinkedIn: OAuth authentication and publishing of content you send to those platforms.

Infrastructure: hosting and storage with providers such as AWS (including S3 for media), Vercel (frontend), and Contabo (API and database in production), plus CDN or DNS when used to deliver the site.
Authorities: only when a valid legal obligation applies, or to protect rights, safety, and the integrity of the service.

storage.title: 6. Storage and retention
body: Account, organization, brand, and post data live in databases operated for Publique. Media files (brand marks, post images, and platform assets) may be stored in private AWS S3 buckets; the API still serves media through authenticated or public endpoints as the use case requires.

We keep data while your account and organization remain active and for as long as needed for the purposes above, dispute resolution, and legal obligations. After closure, we may retain minimum records required by law or needed to defend rights.
Social credentials are encrypted at rest. Technical logs are kept for limited periods suited to diagnostics and security.

rights.title: 7. Your rights
body: Under the LGPD, you may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary data, portability when applicable, information about sharing, and withdrawal of consent when that is the basis used.
To exercise rights, email the contact below, identify yourself, and describe the request. We may ask for additional information to confirm identity and protect the organization account.
If you believe processing violates the LGPD, you may also lodge a complaint with Brazil’s National Data Protection Authority (ANPD).

cookies.title: 8. Cookies and local preferences
body: We use cookies and local storage that are essential to run the product: language preference (locale), authenticated session, and theme preference (light/dark/system).
These are not used for third-party advertising. If we later adopt non-essential analytics or marketing cookies, we will update this policy and, when required, ask for consent.

children.title: 9. Children
body: Publique is a B2B product for businesses and professionals. We do not target children. If we learn we collected a child’s data improperly, we will take reasonable steps to delete it.

changes.title: 10. Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy to reflect changes in the product, infrastructure, or law. The update date appears at the top of the page. For material changes, we may notify you in the product or via the registered email when appropriate.

contact.title: 11. Contact
body: For privacy questions or to exercise data-subject rights, reach us through the channels below.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance
body: By creating an account, accessing, or using Publique, you confirm that you have read and accepted these Terms of service and the Privacy policy. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
If you use Publique on behalf of an organization, you represent that you have authority to bind that organization to these terms.

provider.title: 2. Service provider
body: Publique is provided by the company below. References to “we”, “us”, or “Publique” in these terms mean that provider and the SaaS product under the Publique brand.

service.title: 3. Service description
body: Publique is a B2B platform that helps organizations manage brands, generate content drafts with AI assistance, and, when you connect accounts and request it, publish to supported social networks.

Features may evolve. Capabilities described on the marketing site (including illustrative plans, future networks, or timed autopublish) may not all be available in the current product. What applies to your contracted use is what the product actually offers in your account.
The service depends on third-party providers (for example AI generation, hosting, and social APIs). Outages or changes at those providers may affect Publique.

accounts.title: 4. Accounts and eligibility
body: You must provide accurate information and keep credentials confidential. Activity under your control is your responsibility.
The service is intended for professional and business use. You must have legal capacity to contract. Organization accounts may include invited users with roles defined by the organization.
We may refuse, suspend, or terminate access for breach of these terms, security risk, or abusive use.

acceptableUse.title: 5. Acceptable use
body: You may not use Publique for spam, fraud, harassment, illegal content, infringement of third-party rights, improper reverse engineering, intentional overload of infrastructure, or bypassing technical and security limits.
You must not publish or request generation of content that violates applicable law, the policies of connected social networks, or third-party intellectual property rights.

You may not use the service to invent facts, testimonials, certifications, pricing, statistics, or performance claims about the company or products when those facts are not true or verifiable by the organization.

content.title: 6. Content, AI, and editorial responsibility
body: You (and your organization) remain responsible for content you enter, brand data, uploaded materials, and any publish you initiate from Publique.

AI outputs may contain errors or inaccuracies. Treat drafts as suggestions and review them before publishing. Publique does not guarantee marketing results, reach, engagement, or automatic compliance with every industry rule.
You grant Publique a limited license to process, store, and transmit content as needed to provide the service (including generation, media composition, and publishing to networks you authorize).

social.title: 7. Social networks and third parties
body: By connecting LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, or other supported networks, you authorize Publique to use the credentials and permissions granted via OAuth for the actions you trigger (including publishing).

Use of those platforms remains subject to their own terms and policies. Account suspension, API changes, or limits imposed by the social provider are not Publique’s responsibility when outside our reasonable control.
Publishing and scheduling depend on accounts and permissions you keep valid. Revoking access on the networks may interrupt connected features.

Content you upload or that the organization creates remains owned by the organization or the respective rights holders, without prejudice to the operational license described in these terms.
You may not copy, resell, sublicense, or exploit Publique software outside authorized account use.

plans.title: 9. Plans, pricing, and billing
body: Prices and plans shown on the marketing site may be illustrative. While online billing is not active for your account, any commercial terms (if any) must be agreed in writing or through a commercial channel we designate.
When billing is available, amounts, cycle, taxes, and payment method will be disclosed at purchase or renewal. Applicable taxes may be due under law.

availability.title: 10. Availability and warranty
body: We use reasonable efforts to keep the service available and secure, but we do not warrant uninterrupted, error-free operation or fitness for a particular purpose that is not stated.
Maintenance, network failures, cloud, AI, or social-provider outages may cause temporary unavailability. The service is provided “as is” to the extent permitted by applicable law.

liability.title: 11. Limitation of liability
body: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable Brazilian law, Publique is not liable for lost profits, data loss beyond reasonable operational measures, indirect or consequential damages, or outcomes of campaigns and publishes you choose to run.

Our aggregate liability to you for matters related to these terms is limited, where allowed, to the amounts you actually paid Publique in the twelve months before the event, or to any higher mandatory floor that consumer or civil law makes non-waivable.
Nothing in these terms excludes liability for willful misconduct, gross negligence, or other grounds that the law does not allow to be limited.

termination.title: 12. Suspension and termination
body: You may stop using the service and request account closure through the contact channels, subject to any outstanding obligations.
We may suspend or terminate access for breach of these terms, non-payment (when billing applies), security risk, or legal requirement.
After termination, we may retain data for as long as needed for the legal and operational purposes described in the Privacy policy.

Continued use after publication of material changes constitutes acceptance of the new conditions where the law allows. For material changes, we may notify you in the product or via the registered email.
